title.narrative: UNFPA Turkey - Strengthening national capacities for GBV response

description.narrative:
The project aims to strengthen the effective prevention of and response to gender based violence (GBV) so that women and girls in Turkey live healthy, productive and peaceful lives, out of stigma and discrimination, by enjoying their human rights and bodily autonomy.
The outcome of this project will be to improve the access to and quality of GBV services so that the risks and consequences experienced by women and girls in Turkey are addressed and mitigated. This will be achieved via specialised and comprehensive capacity building activities on gender equality and all forms of GBV, including child, early and forced marriages (CEFM), for law enforcement officials (police and gendarmerie), local government authorities and their spouses.
The outputs of the project will ensure that the capacities built within the timeframe of this project are further scaled up across the country via further trainings provided by law enforcement officials, who received basic and advanced level Training of Trainers, and via advocacy activities organised by local government authorities and their spouses in their cities and towns.
